description: This Python source file defines API routes related to gap analysis for roles within a career development platform. It contains functions to perform gap analysis by comparing current user competencies against the required levels for a target role, utilizing external services with fallback to local database queries. The main route is POST /gap-analysis which returns a detailed assessment of competency gaps.

methods.name: Dict[int,int] _levels_to_map(items: List[CompetencyLevel])
methods.description: Converts a list of CompetencyLevel objects to a dictionary mapping competency IDs to levels.

methods.name: List[tuple[int,str,int]] _required_map_from_db_by_role_id(db: Session, role_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of tuples containing competency IDs, names, and required levels for a given role ID from the database.

methods.name: GapAnalysisResult perform_gap_analysis( payload: GapAnalysisRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Main API handler that performs gap analysis by comparing user competencies with role requirements, utilizing external service and falling back to database lookup as necessary.
